core_obligations: The first square (proof lines 7982-7986): its commutativity follows by combining the commutative diagram of the relocalization result with that of the localization of a morphism of topoi.

The description of the pullback (proof lines 7987-7992): the author combines the description of the pullback in the localized morphism of topoi with the description of the pullback of the second localization to obtain the displayed description of the pullback of the morphism in question.
The last square (proof lines 7993-8002): its commutativity follows from the displayed identity of fibre products of pullbacks, which the author notes is formal.
proof_roadmap: Combine the two commutative diagrams to get the first square.
Combine the two descriptions of pullbacks to describe the pullback of the morphism.
Use the formal identity of fibre products for the last square.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism of topoi and a morphism of sheaves into the pullback of a sheaf on the target there is a commutative diagram of localized topoi, with the morphism written as a composite of the localization of the morphism of topoi and a relocalization, and with an explicit description of its pullback (statement lines 7922-7979). The proof is a complete derivation: the commutativity of the first square is obtained by combining the two relevant commutative diagrams (proof lines 7982-7986); the description of the pullback is obtained by combining the two descriptions supplied by the companion results (proof lines 7987-7992); and the last square follows from an identity of fibre products whose verification the author records as formal (proof lines 7993-8002). The non-formal content is the combination of the two descriptions. The claim is H2: a structured derivation with each input named.
